name: Password Sign-In Passkey Required
summary: Accepts a valid password for an identity that must complete passkey proof before application sign-in can finish, preserving anonymous application state while directing the client to the existing passkey continuation flow.

guards.expression: password authentication is accepted and the account requires passkey proof before application sign-in can complete

sourceReferences.note: Password Sign In should support the same second-factor handoff pattern for passkeys as for TOTP, using the existing passkey continuation surface rather than introducing new presentation.
The canonical passkey continuation surface already exists and is implemented on web and mobile.
The existing Passkey Sign In ceremony owns passkey assertion and authenticated-session completion once the handoff reaches auth.continue.passkey.
